title: He says he ... She says she ... They say they ...
description: A picture lesson about reporting what people say, think, believe, know, hope, fear, and need. 16 pictures illustrate common situations using indirect speech. No dialogue. No new vocabulary section.
answer_note: Answers for practice section A are from the workbook answer key. Textbook written exercises and practice B/C are open-ended (suggested answers). Grammar answers are from the grammar practice book key.

lesson.text: Lesson 102: He says he ... She says she ... They say they ...
lesson.translation: 第102课：他/她/他们说他/她/他们……

lesson.text: Listen and answer the questions. Use the words in the box to describe what the people in the pictures say, think, believe, know, hope, fear, and need.
lesson.translation: 听录音并回答问题。用方框中的词描述图中人们说、想、相信、知道、希望、害怕和需要什么。

lesson.title: Listen and answer the questions
lesson.instruction: Look at the pictures and answer the questions using the words in the box.
lesson.translation: 看图并回答问题，使用方框中的词。
lesson.answer_note: Model answers based on the pictures and word box.
lesson.context: Each picture shows a person in a specific situation. Use the reporting verbs and modal verbs from the word box to describe what they say/think/feel/need.

questions.prompt: Picture 1: A man yawning at his desk (tired)
questions.answer: He says he is tired.
They say they are thirsty.

questions.prompt: Picture 3: A person shivering at a bus stop (cold)
questions.answer: He says he is cold.

questions.prompt: Picture 4: A person lying in bed looking unwell (ill)
questions.answer: She says she is ill.

questions.prompt: Picture 5: A man blowing his nose (a cold)
questions.answer: He says he's got a cold.

questions.prompt: Picture 6: A person holding their head (a headache)
questions.answer: She says she's got a headache.

questions.prompt: Picture 7: A person holding their ear (an earache)
questions.answer: He says he's got an earache.

questions.prompt: Picture 8: Two girls with toothaches (a toothache)
questions.answer: They say they've got a toothache.

questions.prompt: Picture 9: A woman at a hairdresser (a haircut)
questions.answer: She says she needs a haircut.

questions.prompt: Picture 10: A person at a driving test (a licence)
questions.answer: He says he wants a licence.

questions.prompt: Picture 11: A doctor showing an X-ray (an X-ray)
questions.answer: He says he needs an X-ray.

questions.prompt: Picture 12: Two people counting money (some money)
questions.answer: They say they need some money.

questions.prompt: Picture 13: A person waiting at a bus stop (wait)
questions.answer: He says he must wait for the bus.

questions.prompt: Picture 14: A person running to catch a bus (catch)
questions.answer: She says she can catch the bus.

questions.prompt: Picture 15: A person repairing a car (repair)
questions.answer: He says he must repair his car.
He says he will sell his house.

lesson.title: Written exercises A: Rewrite these sentences as indirect speech
lesson.instruction: Rewrite these sentences as indirect speech. Example: He is drinking his milk. → He says he has drunk his milk.
lesson.translation: 模仿例句把下列句子改写成间接引语。例句：他正在喝他的牛奶。→ 他说他已经喝完了他的牛奶。
lesson.answer_note: Model answers converting present continuous to indirect speech.
lesson.context: Convert each present continuous sentence to indirect speech using 'He/She/They says/say that...'

questions.answer: She says she is shutting the door.

questions.prompt: He is putting on his coat.
questions.answer: He says he is putting on his coat.
He says he is reading the magazine.

questions.prompt: They are speaking to the boss.
questions.answer: They say they are speaking to the boss.
He says the sun is rising.

lesson.title: Written exercises B: Write nine sentences using the table
lesson.instruction: Look at this table. Now write nine sentences. Example: He says he feels ill.
lesson.translation: 注意以下表格。利用上表中的短语，模仿例句写出9句话。例句：他说他感到不舒服。
lesson.answer_note: Model sentences combining the verb phrases with the noun/adjective phrases from the table.
lesson.context: Table: He says he [has got / feels / will sell / needs / must wait for] + [cold / a bus / a haircut / tired / a cold / thirsty / an X-ray / an earache / his house / ill]. Write 9 sentences.

questions.answer: He says he has got a cold.
He says he feels tired.
He says he will sell his house.
He says he needs a haircut.
He says he must wait for a bus.
He says he has got an earache.
He says he feels thirsty.
He says he needs an X-ray.
He says he feels ill.

practice.title: Practice A: What does he say?
practice.instruction: Report what people say. Example: He says: 'I feel cold.' → He says he feels cold.
practice.translation: 转述人们说的话。例句：他说：'我感到冷。' → 他说他感到冷。
practice.context: Convert direct speech to indirect speech. Do NOT use 'that'.

questions.answer: He says he feels cold.
She thinks she's got a cold.
I know I need an X-ray.
We know he can swim well.
They believe she is ill.

questions.prompt: I am sure: 'He will sell his house.'
questions.answer: I am sure he will sell his house.

questions.prompt: I am sure: 'She is at home today.'
questions.answer: I am sure she is at home today.
I am sorry she is ill.
I am afraid you are wrong.
I understand you need money.

practice.title: Practice B: A postcard
practice.instruction: Fill in the blanks to write a postcard.
practice.answer_note: Open-ended exercise. Model answer from workbook key.
practice.context: Write a postcard to a friend. The key provides a possible answer.

questions.prompt: Write a postcard: Dear Penny, I have just arrived in London and I'm staying at the Royal Hotel. I'll write you a long letter soon. I hope you and your parents are all well. Love, [your name]
questions.answer: Dear Penny, I have just arrived in London and I'm staying at the Royal Hotel. I'll write you a long letter soon. I hope you and your parents are all well. Love, [your name]

practice.title: Practice C: Situations
practice.answer_note: Open-ended exercise. Model answers from workbook key.
practice.context: Complete each situation with an appropriate response.

questions.answer: I'm afraid I can't hear you.
I think (that) you had better see a doctor.

grammar.title: Grammar I: Choose the correct verb form
grammar.instruction: Choose the correct verb form in each sentence.
grammar.translation: 选择每个句子中正确的动词形式。
grammar.key_source: pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf (Lesson 102 I, PDF p.532)
grammar.context: Choose between two verb forms in each sentence to complete the indirect speech correctly.

questions.prompt: I'm sorry I ___ (don't understand / won't understand).
questions.answer: don't understand
knows
speak
are

questions.prompt: Mrs. Bell says she ___ (has been / is going).
questions.answer: is going
say
won't be

questions.prompt: Mary says she ___ (is having / is going to have).
questions.answer: is going to have
are waiting

questions.prompt: The boy says he ___ (don't want / doesn't want).
questions.answer: doesn't want

grammar.title: Grammar II: Change the sentences to indirect speech
grammar.instruction: Change the sentences to indirect speech. Example: Ann: I'm enjoying myself very much. → Ann says she is enjoying herself very much.
grammar.translation: 把下列句子改成间接引语。例句：安：'我很开心。' → 安说她很开心。
grammar.key_source: pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf (Lesson 102 II, PDF p.532-533)
grammar.context: Convert each direct speech sentence to indirect speech. Item 1 is a printed example.

questions.prompt: Ann: I'm enjoying myself very much.
questions.answer: Ann says she is enjoying herself very much.

questions.prompt: The boys: We're tired and sleepy.
questions.answer: The boys say they're tired and sleepy.

questions.prompt: Mary: I've just washed the dishes.
questions.answer: Mary says she's just washed the dishes.

questions.prompt: Tom: I'm afraid I can't hear you.
questions.answer: Tom says he's afraid he can't hear you/me.

questions.prompt: My daughter: I'll write a letter to you soon.
questions.answer: My daughter says she'll write a letter to you/me soon.

questions.prompt: My husband: I'll take the children to school.
questions.answer: My husband says he'll take the children to school.

questions.prompt: Lucy: I'm still cooking the evening meal.
questions.answer: Lucy says she's still cooking the evening meal.

questions.prompt: The postman: I think I need a big bag for the letters.
questions.answer: The postman says he thinks he needs a big bag for the letters.

questions.prompt: My friends: We've already arrived in Shanghai.
questions.answer: My friends say they've already arrived in Shanghai.
Peter says he feels ill.

grammar.title: Grammar III: Add question tags
grammar.instruction: Add question tags to the sentences according to the example. Example: You can't speak English, can you?
grammar.translation: 仿照例句完成下列附加疑问句。例句：你不会说英语，是吗？
grammar.key_source: pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf (Lesson 102 III, PDF p.533)
grammar.context: Add the correct question tag to each sentence. Item 1 is a printed example.

questions.answer: can you?
are they?
will he?

questions.prompt: It isn't going to rain tomorrow, ___?
questions.answer: is it?
do we?
does she?
does he?
are you?
have we?

questions.prompt: She has never been to Berlin, ___?
questions.answer: has she?
is he?
has she?

items-grid.description: 16 pictures showing people in various situations (tired, thirsty, cold, ill, a cold, a headache, an earache, a toothache, a haircut, a licence, an X-ray, some money, wait, catch, repair, sell) with a word box of reporting verbs and modal verbs
